comment: Gameplay fields whose VALUES are Unity GetInstanceID() integers. Instance ids are process-global allocation counters, so two Unity processes (controlled vs replayed) and the .NET port (monotonic shim counter) can never agree on them, even when behaviour is identical. Unlike presentation-fields.json these fields DO affect gameplay (hit dedup); their effect stays compared through everything downstream: which objects take damage, velocities, deaths. Excluding the raw ids is required for any cross-process trace comparison.

Shockwave.gameObjectIdsHit.reason: HashSet<int> of DetPhysics hit instanceId values (hits[i].instanceId) recording which bodies this shockwave already hit. Dedup behaviour remains compared via the affected bodies' state.

Shockwave.extraObjectsToIgnore.reason: HashSet<int> of instance ids the caster asks the shockwave to skip (AddObjectToIgnore). Skip behaviour remains compared via the affected bodies' state.
